identity: Four ordered cases: change, clear, same, empty. The observed contract contains complete runtime-context messages within two model requests and complete durable runtime-context messages. Other model request fields remain raw and outside this bounded comparison.

ordering: Render named context sections after assembly; project their joined text on every proposed step, before the actual next model call. Do not gate projection on first-step or nonempty contexts.
errors: Source pin, Node version, guard input bytes and candidate imported module closure must validate. The gate rejects absent, duplicated, reordered or altered complete messages without adding bug predicates.
cancellation: Existing agent/Context disposal owns the two-step observation. General cancellation/reentry and public extension ABI remain outside these four cases.
adaptation: Use existing Python3.8 render_context_sections/join_context_sections and RuntimeContextProjection. Opaque random ids normalize by a one-to-one mapping preserving request/history correlations; no frontend or Source algorithm change.
